title: Licensed roofers in Lakeview, New Orleans
gates: An active, unexpired LSLBC license certificate carrying one of these classes: Roofing and Sheet Metal, Siding; Residential Roofing; Residential Construction. No license on the record suspended or revoked.
General liability insurance on file with the LSLBC, not expired.
At least one roofing permit credited to the business name in this area in the last 24 full months.
The license record was read within 45 days.
order: Listed A to Z by business name. The order says nothing about quality, and paying partners never get a better place.
disclosure: Some listed contractors pay Lane Davis II a referral fee when he introduces a customer; that never affects who's listed or the order.
never_shown: homeowner or permit addresses, permit numbers, ratings, reviews, rankings by quality
corrections: Email hello@autoants.com. Put 'Correct' or 'Remove' and the business name in the subject, and include the LSLBC license number. To correct a fact, say which one and link the public record or the page on the business's own site that shows it. To be removed, just say so: the business comes off every Verified Pros page and the New Orleans guide at the next rebuild and stays off, even though the records are public. Both are free.

home_job_classes.rule: Louisiana requires the Residential Roofing or Residential Construction class for a home roof job of $7,500 or more (La. R.S. 37:2156.4, since January 1, 2026)
